units.chapter: 十八问答·第十一问·冲中逢合、合处逢冲
units.chapter_en: Eighteen questions, no. 11: a combination within a clash and a clash within a combination
units.title: 十八问答·第十一问·书中例，占失银物可得复否：卦得六冲，未土财爻化午火回头生合，是失而复得之象；旁人说应爻持白虎金鬼、玄武临财难言复得，作者说应是他人、被午火回头克制，财为用神冲中逢合，日主合它，必得；应在巳火青龙原神旬空出空值日的乙巳日，果然得回

rule.yi: 合是聚、冲是散：冲中逢合，先散后聚，先失后得，先淡后浓；合处逢冲则相反。书中例：寅月戊戌日占丢失的银子和东西能不能失而复得，得巽卦变讼卦：卦得六冲，未土财爻化出午火，回头生合，是失而复得的象；旁人说，应爻持着白虎金鬼，玄武临在财爻，难说能得回；我说，应爻是他人，被午火回头克制，财爻是用神，冲中逢合，日辰又合它，管保一定得到；他问应在哪一天，我说，巳火青龙原神旬空，毛病在巳，必须等乙巳日原神出空值日，会得回；果然应验。
rule.en: A combination gathers and a clash scatters: a combination met within a clash first scatters and then gathers, first loses and then gains, first cool and then warm; a clash met at a combination is the reverse. Worked example: in the Yin month, on a Wuxu day, a man divined whether lost silver and goods could be recovered and got Xun changing to Song: the hexagram has six-clash, the Wealth Wei-earth changes into Wu-fire which gives life and combines in return, the image of lost and then regained; onlookers said that the Other holds the White Tiger and Metal Pressure and the Dark Tortoise sits on Wealth, so it is hard to say it will be recovered; I said that the Other is another person, controlled by Wu-fire in return, that Wealth is the Subject, met with a combination within a clash, with the Day also combining it, so it is bound to be had. He asked on what day, and I said: the Support, the Azure Dragon Si-fire, is Void, so the trouble lies in Si, and one must wait for the Yisi day when the Support comes out of the Void and rules; and indeed it was borne out.

zh: 第十一问：冲中逢合、合处逢冲，何以断其吉凶？
答曰：合者聚也，冲者散也，冲中逢合先散后聚，先失后得，先淡后浓；
yi: 第十一问：冲中逢合、合处逢冲，怎样断吉凶？
回答说：合是聚，冲是散，冲中逢合，先散后聚，先失后得，先淡后浓；
en: Question 11: how are luck and ill judged for a combination within a clash and a clash within a combination?
Answer: a combination gathers and a clash scatters; a combination met within a clash first scatters and then gathers, first loses and then gains, first cool and then warm;
a clash met at a combination is the reverse.

zh: 寅月戊戌日，占失银物可得复否，得巽之讼卦：
yi: 寅月戊戌日，占丢失的银子和东西能不能失而复得，得巽卦变讼卦：
en: In the Yin month, on a Wuxu day, a man divined whether lost silver and goods could be recovered and got Xun changing to Song:

zh: 断曰：卦得六冲，未土财爻化午火回头生合，现失而复得之象。
旁人曰：应持白虎金鬼，玄武临财难言复得。
予曰：应是他人，被午火回头克制，财为用神，冲中逢合，日主合也，管许必得。
答曰：巳火青龙原神旬空，其病在巳，必待乙巳日原神出空值日，当许复得。
yi: 断语：卦得六冲，未土财爻化出午火，回头生合，是失而复得的象。
旁人说：应爻持着白虎金鬼，玄武临在财爻，难说能得回。
我说：应爻是他人，被午火回头克制，财爻是用神，冲中逢合，日辰又合它，管保一定得到。
我说：巳火青龙原神旬空，毛病在巳，必须等乙巳日原神出空值日，会得回。
en: Judgement: the hexagram has six-clash, the Wealth Wei-earth changes into Wu-fire which gives life and combines in return, the image of lost and then regained.
Onlookers said: the Other holds the White Tiger and Metal Pressure and the Dark Tortoise sits on Wealth, so it is hard to say it will be recovered.
I said: the Other is another person, controlled by Wu-fire in return, Wealth is the Subject, met with a combination within a clash, with the Day also combining it, so it is bound to be had.
I said: the Support, the Azure Dragon Si-fire, is Void, so the trouble lies in Si, and one must wait for the Yisi day when the Support comes out of the Void and rules, and it will be recovered.
And indeed it was borne out.
